requirements.basis: The report uses two actual analytical task chains, travel/calendar changes and continuing expense/reimbursement work, to explain what persistent personal service requires. Both cover initial goals, missing information, changed constraints, execution, external receipts and subsequent changes; generic workflow recommendations are distinguished from product capabilities and from testing actually performed. The product comparison preserves dated/current documents, geography, subscription/account/device conditions and prototype versus public-service boundaries across domestic and international examples. Memory is broken into original evidence, task facts, long-term preferences, approved commitments, receipts and credential references, with source/time/scope, conflict, stale updates, correction and deletion propagation. The discussion explicitly separates historical preference, external content, current business authorization and authenticated access. Authorization includes restricted recurring scope, consequential confirmations, trigger conditions, queue/in-flight cancellation, irreversible acts and human recovery. Actual Manus project-update and Gemini stop-task documentation support concrete cross-session and cancellation examples; unresolved queue, provider transaction and cancellation guarantees are identified rather than invented. The report does not claim that its proposed state machine is implemented uniformly by all products. Reliability evidence retains benchmark versions/populations and the narrow third-party observation, without claiming first-hand consumer testing. Local/cloud, API/GUI and ecosystem/cross-platform tradeoffs connect to connector maintenance, credential control and service cost. Subscription, transaction, advertising, device and platform models are related to recommendation incentives, migration and task value; explicit hypothetical economics counts instruction, verification, failure/rework, fees and external losses. Final user/task choices include bounded drafts, human cooperation and deferral of unsupported full delegation. Original R_TASK and frozen/current report match. No material required question is left unanswered within the requirements scope.
